Title: [from] “Doodlebug & Dandelion: Treasure Hunting”
Author: by Pamela Dell
Content: “Don't worry, Rudyard!” Doodlebug said as the camp bus began to roll. “We're gonna have a blast!”

Cousin Rudyard didn't reply. He peered out the window, but he couldn't see his mom anymore. He clutched Pinx, his tiny toy ninja bunny. Pinx kept him safe while he slept. But Rudyard had never slept away from home - except at his cousins' house - ever. The thought of spending four whole nights at Camp Wonkytonka filled him with dread¹.
When they pulled into camp a `text(half hour)` later, Rudyard felt even worse than before.
“It'll be fun, cuz!” Doodlebug shouted as they climbed off the bus. “We'll swim in the lake!”
“But how deep is the water?” Rudyard wanted to know.
Before Doodlebug could answer, a suntanned camp counselor hailed the crowd. “Ahoy, mateys! I'm Wavy Dave. Welcome to Camp Wonkytonka for Happy Boys!”
“I'm not happy,” Rudyard grumbled. But no one heard him amidst all the cheering.
“I have your cabin assignments and `text(daily)` schedules,” Wavy Dave said, passing out sheets of paper. “And check this out-on our last `text(day)`, we're going on a geocaching² adventure!”
Doodlebug shrugged. “Guess we'll find out,” he replied.

That night in Cabin Seven, Doodlebug collapsed on his bunk, tired, sunburned, and happy. Below, on the bottom bunk, Rudyard sighed. His `text(day)` had been O.K. - he'd seen `text(two)` deer in the woods, and the hot dogs at the cookout were delicious. But his mom wasn't there to tuck him in. He hugged Pinx tight against his chest.
The next `text(day)`, Rudyard found he had a hidden skill in archery. He discovered s'mores. But when the cabin lights went out, he still wished he had his dad there to make up a bedtime story.
The `text(third day)`, Rudyard beat `text(four)` opponents in the Camp Wonkytonka Bungee-the-Lake contest. That night, he fell asleep smiling, remembering how everyone had cheered his big win.
